policy.identity: source-qualified candidate id + exact sealed source blob
policy.scope: never generalize narrow results to a family or untested mechanism

assessments.overlap: O has source clocks, freshness invalidation and held-out evaluation, but no released-representation DriftLens threshold substrate or deterministic STL reconstruction contract.
assessments.uncertainty: Current update repairs intended class mapping and artifact provenance only; it does not establish a sequential O-like detector or exact author HDF5 replay.

assessments.overlap: O uses exact ledgers, fail-closed boundaries and explicit fallback/recovery actions, but not an unprojected validity-debt controller whose telescoping identity is preserved by real boundary actions.
assessments.uncertainty: Source guarantees are online conformal selection with model-dependent stochastic efficiency, not O candidate utility or safety.

assessments.overlap: O already separates sealed scorer labels, selector-visible context, mandatory versus optional context and preauthorized held-out receipts; it has not implemented ACS-style adaptive data-reuse/FDR semantics.
assessments.uncertainty: Shared principle is information access control; the statistical guarantee and adaptive reuse protocol remain untested in O.

assessments.overlap: O has watchdog recovery, checkpoints, stale detection, timeouts and anti-stop rules, but no proved restart/doubling wrapper targeting the stopping-time tail of search units.
assessments.uncertainty: BAI liveness contracts do not directly transfer to heterogeneous nonrestartable tool trajectories.

assessments.overlap: O runs small paired route/task comparisons but has no e-process bettor selection or explicit separation of deadline-crossing utility from typical/final evidence quality.
assessments.uncertainty: Worker result is simulation under stationary independent task-pair assumptions.

assessments.overlap: O has no fixed-versus-predictable-plugin-versus-mixture e-process family calibrated for 10-50 independent paired tasks.
assessments.uncertainty: Prior center/strength and mixture grid are experiment-specific; no universal bettor is established.

assessments.overlap: O records task outcomes, scopes and claim boundaries, but not discordant information rate, unresolved fraction and terminal evidence distribution as a standard paired-sequential report.
assessments.uncertainty: Exact reporting fields need adaptation for nonbinary O outcomes.

assessments.overlap: O values held-out/protected evaluation but does not currently re-optimize an attacker specifically against each tested defense/evaluator before accepting robustness claims.
assessments.uncertainty: USENIX results are defense-specific threat models and must not be generalized to every deployment or one universal attack.

assessments.overlap: O separates private rubrics and isolated route responses, but has no matched adaptive monitor-aware prompt-injection attack or least-suspicious-resampling stress test.
assessments.uncertainty: Quantified result is specific to APPS/BashBench control protocols, monitor models and attack budgets.

assessments.overlap: O already treats context selection and protected regressions as decision-critical, but has not tested defensive fine-tuning for contextual-authority manipulation or attack-recognition backfire.
assessments.uncertainty: Failure is scoped to conditional-delegation/email-assistant settings and does not establish global SecAlign inferiority.

assessments.overlap: O already requires matched frozen comparisons, exact tested scope and no family-level inference from multi-factor changes; its current paired-route harness explicitly freezes routes/scenarios/budgets/judge before conclusions.
assessments.uncertainty: External source is still useful corroboration, but it does not add a new O mechanism.

assessments.overlap: O has checkpointed/fenced recovery and exact continuations, but does not choose among historical rollback nodes by posterior root-cause probability versus replay/regeneration cost.
assessments.uncertainty: Hydra selector ablation is C++ compiler-error recovery and retry-policy details are not literally budget-identical.

assessments.overlap: O has reversible scoped Candidates and evidence ledgers but no MAP-Elites/QD archive overstatement metric, corrected archive reevaluation or explicit false-admit/false-reject archive accounting.
assessments.uncertainty: UQD noise is fitness/descriptor uncertainty rather than semantic LLM-judge bias.

assessments.overlap: O has repeated candidate activation and frozen evidence boundaries but no online FDR/e-value wealth controller or proof that candidate-local anytime validity composes under adaptive archive feedback.
assessments.uncertainty: Statistical hypotheses/e-process assumptions for O-generated candidates are not established.

assessments.overlap: O has deterministic candidate/effect admission rules and matched evaluation, but no public-data synthetic asymmetric false-admit/false-reject sweep at a frozen deterministic eligibility boundary.
assessments.uncertainty: Replay is selection-layer synthetic corruption and omits hidden online generation/archive feedback.

assessments.overlap: No astrocyte-gated associative-memory mechanism is implemented or evaluated in O.
assessments.uncertainty: Corrected-Hamming reproduction contradicts the broad across-grid comparative claim while retaining a narrow high-load/low-corruption effect.

assessments.overlap: O already implements authenticated execution ownership through generation/fence/CAS/readback, manifest-bound effect authorization and dispatch-time authority/revocation rechecks rather than caller-supplied role strings.
assessments.uncertainty: Argus finding is source-level capability reachability, not a live exploit; O's own final provider-side race remains a separate boundary.

assessments.overlap: O has persistent Candidates/Episodes and strict frozen-control provenance, but no Memento CBR protocol and no identified equivalent of its unexplained no-memory inter-iteration operator.
assessments.uncertainty: This remains an ablation-audit limitation, not evidence the paper values are false.

assessments.overlap: O's Context Kernel already uses compact mandatory projections, selective recursive retrieval, sealed scorer isolation and immutable external artifacts, but has not evaluated OpenProver-style branch-local Worker isolation or a free-form heterogeneous meta-action planner on the same action set/budget.
assessments.uncertainty: Matched output-token budget does not equal matched wall-clock/input/verifier/parallelism cost; component attribution is unresolved.

assessments.overlap: O has an evidence hierarchy and can choose different evaluation routes, but no adaptive cheap-fidelity adequacy gate that measures proxy discriminability/rank preservation before escalating to full fidelity.
assessments.uncertainty: Rocket thresholds are HPO-specific empirical defaults, not universal experiment-validity constants.

assessments.overlap: O preserves contradictions, supports rerun/method-change triggers and scoped claim downgrade, but lacks a typed review-closure rule that distinguishes disclosure-only from evidence-changing repair after a severe self-critique.
assessments.uncertainty: Two manually inspected trajectories reveal a mechanism but cannot estimate prevalence or population repair rate.

assessments.overlap: O already keeps Candidates scoped/reversible and performs Local Learn, but does not implement a frozen-worker persistent skill-bank lifecycle with same-task counterfactual Keep/Rewrite/Remove attribution plus bank-level diversity/coverage selection.
assessments.uncertainty: Primary-paper evidence lacks independent reproduction; repeated outer query-set reuse has an adaptive-overfitting exposure.
